```{r}

install.packages("httr2")

library(httr2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)


```

# Setting Up API

First trying to filter for DRC and check API connection

```{r}


# Request the first five DRC contracts
response_drc <- request(
  "https://api.resourcecontracts.org/contracts/search"
) |>
  req_url_query(
    group = "metadata",
    country_code = "cd",
    per_page = 5,
    from = 0
  ) |>
  req_perform()

# Parse the response
drc_test <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  resp_body_string(response_drc),
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)

# How many contracts match?
drc_test$total

# What mineral resources appear in the first five?
drc_test$resource

# What fields does each contract record contain?
if (length(drc_test$results) > 0) {
  names(drc_test$results[[1]])
}



```

This appears to be working. Moving on to the next step now.

# Cobalt agreements from DRC

```{r}

# Search for cobalt-related agreements in the DRC

response_cobalt <- request(
  "https://api.resourcecontracts.org/contracts/search"
) |>
  req_url_query(
    group = "metadata",
    country_code = "cd",
    resource = "Cobalt",
    per_page = 5,
    from = 0
  ) |>
  req_perform()

# Convert the response to an R object
cobalt_test <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  resp_body_string(response_cobalt),
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)

# Number of matching agreements
cobalt_test$total

# Number of records retrieved
length(cobalt_test$results)

# Examine the first contract
if (length(cobalt_test$results) > 0) {
  str(cobalt_test$results[[1]], max.level = 2)
}

```

there are 136 relevant records about cobalt (note that this includes contracts including cobalt not contracts exclusively about cobalt)

## Retrieve every matching contract

```{r}

# Number of contracts to retrieve per request
page_size <- 25

# Starting positions for each request
offsets <- seq(
  from = 0,
  to = cobalt_test$total - 1,
  by = page_size
)

# Function to retrieve one batch
fetch_page <- function(offset) {

  response <- request(
    "https://api.resourcecontracts.org/contracts/search"
  ) |>
    req_url_query(
      group = "metadata",
      country_code = "cd",
      resource = "Cobalt",
      per_page = page_size,
      from = offset
    ) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  body <- resp_body_string(response)

  if (!jsonlite::validate(body)) {
    stop("API did not return valid JSON.")
  }

  data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
    body,
    simplifyVector = FALSE
  )

  data$results
}

# Retrieve all batches
pages <- lapply(offsets, fetch_page)

# Combine batches into one list
all_contracts <- unlist(
  pages,
  recursive = FALSE
)

# Verify the number retrieved
length(all_contracts)


```

Then creating a data frame

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

# Handle missing metadata values
scalar_value <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_
  else as.character(x[[1]])
}

# Combine multiple labels in one cell
multi_value <- function(x) {
  paste(unlist(x), collapse = "; ")
}

# Convert the contract records to a table
inventory <- bind_rows(
  lapply(all_contracts, function(x) {
    tibble(
      id = x$id,
      contract_id = scalar_value(x$open_contracting_id),
      title = scalar_value(x$name),
      year = as.integer(scalar_value(x$year_signed)),
      contract_type = multi_value(x$contract_type),
      resources = multi_value(x$resource),
      language = scalar_value(x$language),
      ocr_reviewed = isTRUE(x$is_ocr_reviewed)
    )
  })
)

# Inspect the inventory
View(inventory)

# Examine the different agreement types
inventory |>
  count(contract_type, sort = TRUE)

# Examine the years represented
inventory |>
  count(year, sort = FALSE)

# Check unique record IDs
n_distinct(inventory$id)

```

Save as a csv so I don't have to query the api every time

```{r}

# Create folders if they don't exist
dir.create("data/raw", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Preserve the complete API metadata
saveRDS(
  all_contracts,
  "data/raw/drc_cobalt_metadata.rds"
)

# Export the simplified document inventory
write_csv(
  inventory,
  "data/drc_cobalt_inventory.csv"
)

```

## Filter by Joint Venture Agreement

```{r}


# Select only joint-venture agreements
jva_inventory <- inventory |>
  filter(contract_type == "Joint Venture Agreement") |>
  arrange(year)

# Confirm the number of agreements
nrow(jva_inventory)

# Examine the documents
jva_inventory |>
  select(
    id,
    year,
    title,
    resources,
    language,
    ocr_reviewed
  ) |>
  print(n = 48)

# Count OCR-reviewed and non-reviewed documents
jva_inventory |>
  count(ocr_reviewed)

# Save the filtered inventory
write_csv(
  jva_inventory,
  "data/drc_cobalt_jva_inventory.csv"
)

```

# API contract text retrieval

```{r}

library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# Select one of our 48 agreements
test_id <- jva_inventory$id[1]

# Retrieve its text
response_text <- request(
  paste0(
    "https://api.resourcecontracts.org/contract/",
    test_id,
    "/text"
  )
) |>
  req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
  req_perform()

# Parse response as JSON
body <- resp_body_string(response_text)

stopifnot(jsonlite::validate(body))

contract_text <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  body,
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)

# Examine the API response
names(contract_text)
str(contract_text, max.level = 2)

```

```{r}

# Handle either documented response key
pages <- if (!is.null(contract_text$result)) {
  contract_text$result
} else {
  contract_text$results
}

stopifnot(length(pages) > 0)

# One row per contract page
page_text <- bind_rows(
  lapply(pages, function(p) {
    tibble(
      contract_id = test_id,
      page = as.integer(p$page_no),
      text = if (is.null(p$text)) "" else p$text
    )
  })
) |>
  arrange(page)

# Check how much text is available
page_text |>
  mutate(characters = nchar(text)) |>
  select(contract_id, page, characters) |>
  print(n = 20)

# Examine the text
cat(substr(page_text$text[1], 1, 1500))

# Save the text locally
dir.create(
  "data/raw/contract_text",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  page_text,
  paste0("data/raw/contract_text/", test_id, ".rds")
)

```

Perfect, so retrieving the text is working.

# Download Joint Venture Contract Text

```{r}


library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# Function to retrieve one complete contract
fetch_contract_text <- function(id) {

  response <- request(
    paste0(
      "https://api.resourcecontracts.org/contract/",
      id,
      "/text"
    )
  ) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  body <- resp_body_string(response)

  if (!jsonlite::validate(body)) {
    stop("Invalid JSON for contract ", id)
  }

  result <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
    body,
    simplifyVector = FALSE
  )

  pages <- if (!is.null(result$result)) {
    result$result
  } else {
    result$results
  }

  if (length(pages) == 0) {
    stop("No pages returned for contract ", id)
  }

  # Convert pages to a table
  bind_rows(lapply(pages, function(p) {
    tibble(
      contract_id = id,
      page = as.integer(p$page_no),
      text = if (is.null(p$text)) "" else p$text
    )
  }))
}

# Directory for original contract text
dir.create(
  "data/raw/contract_text",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Download every agreement, skipping saved files
for (id in jva_inventory$id) {

  file <- paste0(
    "data/raw/contract_text/",
    id,
    ".rds"
  )

  if (file.exists(file)) next

  tryCatch({

    pages <- fetch_contract_text(id)
    saveRDS(pages, file)

    message("Saved contract ", id)

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Failed contract ", id, ": ", e$message)
  })

  Sys.sleep(1)
}

# Check how many contracts were saved
sum(file.exists(
  paste0(
    "data/raw/contract_text/",
    jva_inventory$id,
    ".rds"
  )
))
```
